title: Happy Ripe Fruit
shareTitle: Happy Ripe Fruit - Pick the Just-Right Fruit
description: Look closely at color, shape, sheen, and texture to pick the fruit that is just right.
learningGoals: Compare visible stages of fruit ripeness
Practice careful observation and visual discrimination
interactionModel: Tap a ripe fruit or drag it into a forgiving woven basket across six sequential orchard patches.
feedbackModel: Recorded teacher prompts, stage-aware hints, tactile fruit motion, sparkles, filling baskets, and collectible patch badges.

modes.title: Rainbow Orchard
modes.skill: Compare early, ripe, and late fruit stages and pick the ripe one.
